profile.name: Luminos多轴精密定位台
profile.description: Luminos多轴精密定位台是一种电动位移与角度调节平台，可提供线性轴和旋转轴运动，用于在实验室中对光学元件、光纤、样品或探头进行高精度定位、对准和扫描。此类设备常用于光学耦合、器件装调和精密运动控制实验。
profile.description_en: The Luminos multi-axis precision positioning stage is a motorized positioning platform that provides linear and rotational motion for high-precision placement, alignment, and scanning of optical components, fibers, samples, or probes in the laboratory. It is commonly used for optical coupling, component alignment, and precision motion-control experiments.
